title: Fallible call whose error is silently dropped

m2.note: a Result in statement position is a compile error (E_UNHANDLED_RESULT); `let _ = ...` discards it explicitly

moonbit.note: idiomatic MoonBit uses checked `raise`; calling a raising function without handling it is a compile error

rust.note: unused Result is a `must_use` warning, not an error

go.note: a discarded error return compiles silently (go vet has no errcheck)
